_note: Styles that belong to paying clients (status: owned) or to AVE's own portfolio. A new prospect style must not copy any of these. Add every new client here the day they pay. Prospect styles live in styles/ with status sample.

styles.caption_font: condensed bold sans (Bebas Neue / Oswald / Anton look)
styles.caption_color: white, soft drop shadow, no box
styles.accent: lime #C8F82C on one key word per caption; key numbers/punchlines 2-3x bigger on their own line
styles.caption_animation: short ~3-frame fade per phrase, no word-by-word pop
styles.graphics: thin lime line-art story graphics: typed-on hook title, counter tag, dashed circle highlight, data grid, count-up number, jittering boxed punchline, dial/echo stack
styles.hook: left-aligned 3-line typed title with kicker over the wide shot
styles.framing: three shot sizes (wide, MCU, wide on big laugh, CU tag), hard cuts only
styles.end_card: freeze/blur, centred handle with thin lime underline + special name
styles.signature: story graphics that illustrate the exact line being said

styles.source: delivered clips (Nov 2026); details not written down yet
